answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The delta edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 112 clones produces a signature the ivory analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the sable settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
